notes.title: Animation Update
notes.notes:
Hello,
Sorry for not making an update post last month. Last month was pretty hectic I did an internal beta testing and took a short break of 2-3 weeks.

I am working on EOD since last August full time daily working on the game for 8-10 hrs exhausted me which result in burnout. Thatswhay I decided to take a short break in May to recharge my batteries.
After internal beta testing results were not promising for me. The game feels rough around edges and consists of game threatening bugs. I could have released the game and with the label of "Early Access" made some excuses and promises update etc. but doing such things are not worth it. I set some standards and I am not releasing the game without matching it. I am well aware of my limitations and not expecting to release a masterpiece or something but releasing a broken game in the name early access is not something I want to do as it will not represent efforts, I put in the game last year.


[b]Animation Update[/b]

In past blogs, I explained the swordplay system sword is controlled from the input of the mouse and it will rotate with the mouse direction but In past system animations were static that means if you move the mouse in left direction animation system will play left targetting animation but with the new system and introduction of ik, animations are much flexible. The player can target a specific part of an enemy body like legs.hands.neck, head etc. Which gives different tactical options to both Ai and players.

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Hello,
1) The major challenge of creating this game is to render thousands of Ai soldier each with individual ai etc. Few games in a similar category as of this game gives the ability to the player to run riot with thousands of ai soldiers but not allowed to control a single soldier or player character In case of RPG games max count of the individual soldier is in few hundreds each with unique ai and physics. While making EOD I want to blend both things together to give player ability to control thousands of soldier and also kill enemy soldiers with his sword. In early build maximum amount of soldiers controlled by the player are 700-1000(30-45fps). Last month I spend the majority of time to solve this problem because king with an army of 500 soldiers is just idiotic. So I need to rewrite 80% my previously written code, trade-off many things and finally, I can render soldiers I always wish for. In my last test, I can manage to run with 7500-11000 soldier at solid 60 fps on GTX 1050ti. I am still improving many things from pathfinding to collision checking but I am happy with the progress I made.
2)Towns and Villages: In EOD, I almost changed over 10s of times their design I am still not satisfied with it but I am planning to improve them later on early access.
3)NPC-Ai: Now each NPC ai will have their own schedule but they are not just brain-dead zombies roaming from one place to another. They will act and behave according to player actions
4)How complete is the game: To be fair If I want I can release game even tomorrow but I keep adding things into it. Anyways also all images and trailer are from last build game look much better now. After confirming a few things I will change them later.
